description: Get a time series of exchange rates for a base currency over a date range (max ~1 year), useful for trend analysis. Provide start and end as YYYY-MM-DD and one or more target currencies.

end.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (MM/DD/YYYY is also accepted).

start.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (MM/DD/YYYY is also accepted). Range up to about one year.

name: fx_timeseries
title: FX Timeseries
